latin: Voluntas antecedens sic potest describi: Voluntas dei antecedens est illa qua deus dat alicui naturalia uel antecedentia quibus potest aliquid consequi, cui deus paratus est coagere si alius uelit, nec sibi contrarium manifestabit cum praecepto uel consilio exequendi, permittens eum libere uelle agere ad consequutionem suae salutis.
translation: The antecedent will can be described thus: God's antecedent will is that by which God gives to someone natural gifts or antecedent conditions by which he can attain something -- something God is ready to cooperate in bringing about if the person is willing, and to which he will not make known anything contrary by way of a precept or a counsel to be carried out, permitting him freely to will to act toward the attainment of his salvation.
